params.name: subdomain
params.description: Used to scope the request to the specified institution

params.name: start_cursor
params.description: First item of the current page. Starts empty

params.name: end_cursor
params.description: Last item of the current page. Starts empty

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results to return per page. Maximum allowed amount is 1000.

params.name: sort
params.description:
Optional comma-separated string of fields to sort on.
Include a leading dash for descending order.

Available fields:
  * updated_at
  * -updated_at

params.name: location_id
params.description: Only return providers associated with the specified Location Id

params.name: foreign_id
params.description: Unique provider id from the EHR

params.name: requestable
params.description: Only return providers who are bookable via NexHealth online booking at the specified location_id

params.name: inactive
params.description: Filter result set based on inactive status, defaults to false if not specified

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Query providers whose records have updated since the specified datetime in ISO8601 format. Must be a parseable Date, recommended formats are YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss+0000

params.name: include[]
params.description: Resources to be included in the response

items.docs: This endpoint returns the providers for the institution, narrowed down by the optional filters configured.
